aboutAuthor.headline: Hi, I'm Tonia Ojomo.
aboutAuthor.role: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner · Clinical Educator · Creator of Psych Mastery
aboutAuthor.bio: I created Psychiatric Assessment Mastery because I remember what it felt like — walking into a clinical rotation with textbook knowledge but no practical script. The fear of saying the wrong thing to a vulnerable patient. The panic of staring at a blank SOAP note. I wrote this guide in simple, clear English so that every student — especially ESL learners and new graduates — can feel confident from day one.
aboutAuthor.mission: My mission is simple: make psychiatric education accessible, practical, and free of unnecessary jargon. Every template, phrase bank, and teaching tool in this workbook was built from real clinical experience.
